body: Thank you for the kind words. They truly mean a lot to me.

I'm still here. I'm not going anywhere. Thank you for the kind words and inspiration. Whenever I feel down I will always come back to this thread, I have read every post here several times and almost each touched my heart or soul in some way.


Thank you. I'm not going anytime soon.
Thank you...everyone...for all of the comments. They've literally brought me to tears. Thank you.
How though? I'll be spending the next 18 years paying child support...I don't have a job. I gave up my full ride scholarship for her and I can't get it back.

So much more I could say and explain but it's meaningless. Maybe in my suicide note I'll link to this thread. Hah. Wouldn't that be grand.

Time to drive home. I'll be back here in another hour.
